# Project Learning Tree

> Project Learning Tree provides environmental education curriculum, teacher training, and student activities aligned to national standards for K-12 schools.

PLT is a nonprofit organization offering comprehensive STEM-based environmental education resources including online courses, in-person workshops, lesson plans, and school sustainability programs. The organization serves educators, school districts, and students through its GreenSchools initiative and multiple curriculum guides.

## Key Topics

- Environmental Education
- Teacher Professional Development
- GreenSchools Program
- STEM Curriculum
- K-8 Activities
- Online Courses
- Green Careers
- School Sustainability
- Outdoor Learning
- Standards Alignment
- Carbon & Climate
- Forest Literacy
- Student Investigations
- Curriculum Resources
- Educational Products

## Professional Development & Training

- [Attend a Training](https://www.plt.org/trainings/attend-a-training): Find and register for PLT in-person and online training workshops
- [Online Courses](https://www.plt.org/trainings/online): Self-paced online courses for environmental education and forest literacy
- [Examples of Our Trainings](https://www.plt.org/examples-of-trainings): Overview of PLT online and in-person training formats and options
- [2025 Project Learning Tree Conference](https://www.plt.org/conference): PLT annual conference details and registration information

## Curriculum & Learning Resources

- [Sample Student Activities](https://www.plt.org/sample-lesson-plans): Free downloadable sample lesson plans and activities for K-12 students
- [Alignment to Standards](https://www.plt.org/alignment-to-standards): PLT curriculum alignment to Common Core and state standards
- [Project Learning Tree Shop](https://shop.plt.org): Online shop for PLT STEM curriculum resources and educational products

## GreenSchools Program

- [Engage Your Students](https://www.plt.org/greenschools/engage-your-students): GreenSchools program guide for student environmental investigations
- [Download GreenSchools Investigations](https://www.plt.org/green-schools/download-student-investigations): Downloadable GreenSchools student investigations for sustainability projects
- [GreenSchools for Early Childhood](https://www.plt.org/greenschools/early-childhood): GreenSchools program resources for early childhood educators

## For School Districts

- [School Districts](https://www.plt.org/schools): Information for school districts implementing PLT environmental curriculum

## Support & Information

- [FAQs](https://www.plt.org/faq): Frequently asked questions about PLT workshops, materials, and pricing
